answers.how: The deer moves about 264 pixels in 2.467 seconds, giving a scale of 0.0119 m/pixel. The rabbit is about 36 pixels long.
Using the deer-motion scale of approximately 0.0119 m/pixel, its average nose-to-tail extent of about 261 pixels gives the length.
The rabbit moves about 254 pixels while the deer moves about 264 pixels over the same interval: 1.277 × 254/264.
